validation_notes: The right side of the chart (Jun 15 - Aug 04) shows a relatively flat, choppy consolidation between roughly 1.05 and 1.20, not a clear converging triangle. There's no well-defined descending resistance line with consistently lower highs - the highs bounce around in a range (e.g., ~1.20 in late Jun, ~1.18 in mid-Jul, ~1.17 in late Jul) without clean convergence toward the flat support near 1.05-1.07. This looks more like sideways consolidation/basing after a steep downtrend than a descending triangle. The price action lacks the progressively tightening range needed for a credible triangle; it's more of a rectangle/range-bound pattern with noisy touches on both sides.
